source_text.ISS-0347: Backend CI lint_handoffs (mix letflow.check) fails on main. Two causes: (1) handoff schema check rejects top-level next_action key and PASS status value actually used throughout the pipeline (recurring class, see ISS-0342/ISS-0345). (2) mix letflow.lint_handoffs raises BadMapError in Mix.Tasks.Letflow.LintHandoffs.print_advisory/1 (lib/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs.ex:697) while iterating advisory entries. Full description in docs/issues/ISS-0347.yaml.
